svg.text: 3.3 V logic on the DATA2 connector. SPI0, I2C0 and the GPIO are Zynq EMIO signals routed to the pins in the bitstream. No on-chip ADC input.
adapter J12: tied high, or SBC pin
GND star point (one place, near the SBC)
Supplies are not wired from the SBC. The pins of DATA1 (AD9226, later) and DATA3 are not used by the sweep: see ebaz-data1-pinout.svg and ebaz-data3-pinout.svg.
